items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: And there was that date you made with Herb Moran.

ctx.x: I did too, that's right. And Big Eye Louie and Joe Nicholas. That's the records we...

I wasn't, let's see, I don't believe you made the records quite at 1950. Yeah. Push it. Well, we were just saying you started recording there with Albert Burbank. And there was that date you made with Herb Moran. And then you made some with Wooden Joe that year. Yeah, I cannot...
It was 1949, I guess, when we made those records.

items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: But y'all were playing uptown someplace with Clarence Gabriel and Burbank and Moran.

ctx.x: Well that's the time we was playing. I see.

But y'all were playing uptown someplace with Clarence Gabriel and Burbank and Moran. I think it was on Chaputulas. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, that's right. What's the name of that place? I got a picture of it. I don't remember the name of that place. I don't remember the name of that place.

Where was it again? I was playing uptown someplace with Clarence Gabriel and Burbank and Moran. I remember that. Was that a fraternity? I think it was on Chaputulas. Oh yeah, yeah, that's right. What was the name of that place? I got a picture of it. I don't remember the name of that place.
